nodes.description: Multi-tenant AI-powered employee scheduling web application

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.description: Python 3.11+ backend using FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.x (Async), PostgreSQL, Alembic

nodes.label: React Frontend
nodes.description: React 18+, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS frontend application

nodes.label: LangGraph Scheduling Pipeline
nodes.description: Agentic pipeline embedded in FastAPI backend that generates optimized weekly shift schedules per location using LangGraph + Anthropic Claude

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: PostgreSQL 16+ database with async access via asyncpg and SQLAlchemy 2.x

nodes.label: Anthropic Claude
nodes.description: LLM used by the scheduling pipeline via the Anthropic Python SDK (async)

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.description: JWT-based auth using python-jose + passlib[bcrypt], token payload includes sub, company_id, user_role, exp

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy
nodes.description: Every query filters by company_id extracted from the authenticated user's JWT at the application layer

nodes.label: Availability Draft
nodes.description: Deep copy of employee availability in SchedulingState, mutated after each location to prevent cross-location double-booking

nodes.label: NDJSON Streaming
nodes.description: POST /schedules/generate returns StreamingResponse(media_type='application/x-ndjson'), one JSON line per completed location

nodes.label: load_location_context
nodes.description: Graph node: fetches shift template + eligible employees for current location, filters availability against availability_draft

nodes.label: build_prompt
nodes.description: Graph node: calls prompts.build_schedule_prompt() with parameterized role names from shift template

nodes.label: call_llm
nodes.description: Graph node: invokes Claude via Anthropic Python SDK (async), stores raw response text

nodes.label: parse_schedule
nodes.description: Graph node: extracts JSON array from LLM response, sets status=PARSE_ERROR on failure, never raises

nodes.label: validate_and_update_availability
nodes.description: Graph node: checks availability_draft for overlaps, retries once on conflict, marks CONFLICT on second failure

nodes.label: emit_result
nodes.description: Graph node: yields one NDJSON line with location_id, shifts, errors, status

nodes.label: SchedulingState
nodes.description: TypedDict holding company_id, week_start_date, locations, shift_templates, employees, availability_draft, progress, and draft_schedules

nodes.label: ShiftAssignment
nodes.description: TypedDict with employee_id, role_id, role_name, location_id, date, start_time, end_time, status

nodes.label: LocationResult
nodes.description: TypedDict with location_id, location_name, shifts (list of ShiftAssignment), errors, status

nodes.label: useScheduleStream Hook
nodes.description: React hook consuming NDJSON stream from /schedules/generate using Fetch Streams API (response.body.getReader())

nodes.label: DataTable Component
nodes.description: Reusable inline-editable table supporting column definitions, cell editing, row save/discard, optional bulk-action toolbar

nodes.label: useAuth Hook
nodes.description: React hook managing JWT in localStorage, login/logout state, attaches Bearer token to all requests

nodes.label: apiFetch
nodes.description: Shared typed fetch wrapper in src/api/ with Bearer token attachment

nodes.label: Schedule Page
nodes.description: Manager page for AI schedule generation with WeekPicker, progress bar, per-location review with approve/reject/edit

nodes.label: Bulk CSV Upload
nodes.description: POST /employees/bulk-upload accepts multipart CSV, matches role names case-insensitively against roles table

nodes.label: Roles Never Hardcoded Convention
nodes.description: Design decision: no role name string literal may appear outside seed.py. Every role reference must come from the roles table. This ensures the system is fully dynamic for any tenant's role definitions.

nodes.label: Defensive LLM Parsing
nodes.description: Design decision: parse LLM output defensively, never raise unhandled exceptions inside the graph. On parse failure set status=PARSE_ERROR, store raw_llm_output, emit result, continue.

nodes.label: Serial Location Processing
nodes.description: Design decision: locations are processed serially in a single graph run so that availability_draft can be mutated after each location to prevent cross-location double-booking.

nodes.label: Single Retry on Conflict
nodes.description: Design decision: on scheduling conflict, retry once with conflict notes added to prompt. On second conflict, mark shift as CONFLICT and continue. Balances quality with latency.

nodes.label: JWT in localStorage
nodes.description: Design decision: store JWT in localStorage, acceptable for MVP. Simpler than httpOnly cookies for the initial version.

nodes.label: Terraform Infrastructure
nodes.description: Terraform IaC for deploying WizScheduler to AWS with ECS Fargate, RDS, ALB, Secrets Manager

nodes.label: AWS ECS Fargate
nodes.description: Container orchestration: 512 CPU / 1024 MiB tasks in private subnets, behind ALB

nodes.label: AWS RDS PostgreSQL
nodes.description: db.t3.micro instance in private subnets, encrypted, 7-day backups, PostgreSQL 15.4

nodes.label: AWS Application Load Balancer
nodes.description: Public-facing ALB in public subnets, health check on /health endpoint

nodes.label: AWS Secrets Manager
nodes.description: Stores DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY with scoped IAM access

nodes.label: AWS CloudWatch
nodes.description: Container logs via awslogs driver, /ecs/wizscheduler log group, 30-day retention, structured JSON logs

nodes.label: AWS ECR
nodes.description: Container registry for WizScheduler Docker images

nodes.label: AWS VPC
nodes.description: VPC with public subnets (ALB, NAT), private subnets (ECS, RDS), single NAT gateway for cost optimization

nodes.label: Single NAT Gateway
nodes.description: Design decision: single NAT Gateway keeps costs low. For production HA, add a NAT per AZ.

nodes.label: Security Groups
nodes.description: ALB accepts TCP 80/443 from internet, ECS accepts 8000 from ALB SG only, RDS accepts 5432 from ECS SG only. No direct internet to ECS or DB.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI/CD
nodes.description: deploy.yml workflow for automated build, test, and deploy

nodes.label: Locust Load Tests
nodes.description: Load tests simulating 10,000 managers through full workflow: register, setup, create templates, generate schedules

nodes.label: Multi-stage Dockerfile
nodes.description: Stage 1: node:20-alpine builds frontend. Stage 2: python:3.11-slim runs backend, serves static in production.

nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.description: Services: postgres, backend, frontend (dev profile). Backend depends on postgres health. Env vars via .env file.

nodes.label: Seed Script
nodes.description: Idempotent seed.py inserting demo company (Acme Corp), manager, employee, roles, region, location, shift template, availability

nodes.label: Alembic Migrations
nodes.description: Database migrations managed by Alembic in backend/alembic/

nodes.label: robots.txt
nodes.description: SEO config: allows /, /login, /register, /privacy-policy, /terms; disallows /manager/, /employee/, /api/. Sitemap at wizscheduler.com.

nodes.label: OG Image
nodes.description: UI screenshot showing Schedule Generation page with dark theme, sidebar navigation, week date picker, grid schedule view by role (Floor Associate, Team Lead) across weekdays, approve/reject buttons. Shows the manager schedule review workflow.

nodes.label: Favicon SVG
nodes.description: 500x500 SVG favicon with a wizard/hat shape rendered as a complex path in dark blue (#22358E)

nodes.label: companies table
nodes.description: id (UUID PK), name, slug (unique), created_at

nodes.label: users table
nodes.description: id, company_id (FK companies), email (unique), hashed_password, full_name, user_role (manager|employee)

nodes.label: regions table
nodes.description: id, company_id, name, geo_bounds (JSON)

nodes.label: locations table
nodes.description: id, company_id, region_id (FK regions), name, address, geo_coord (JSON), timezone

nodes.label: roles table
nodes.description: id, company_id, name (user-defined, never hardcoded), description

nodes.label: employees table
nodes.description: id, company_id, user_id (FK users, nullable), full_name, email, location_ids (ARRAY UUID)

nodes.label: employee_roles table
nodes.description: id, company_id, employee_id, role_id, skill_level (1-5)

nodes.label: employee_affinities table
nodes.description: id, company_id, employee_id, target_employee_id, level (-1.0 to 1.0). Hard constraints at +/-1.

nodes.label: employee_availability table
nodes.description: id, company_id, employee_id, year, month, day, start_time (tz), end_time (tz)

nodes.label: shift_templates table
nodes.description: id, company_id, location_id, name, weekly_schedule (JSON with day_of_week, roles array)

nodes.label: shift_schedules table
nodes.description: id, company_id, location_id, week_start_date, status (draft|approved|rejected), raw_llm_output, created_at

nodes.label: shifts table
nodes.description: id, company_id, shift_schedule_id, location_id, employee_id, role_id, role_name (denormalized), date, start_time, end_time

nodes.label: Health Check Endpoint
nodes.description: GET /health endpoint for ALB/ECS health probes

nodes.label: Security Headers Middleware
nodes.description: X-Frame-Options, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options middleware for production security

nodes.label: Welcome Email
nodes.description: Transactional email sent on manager registration via Resend API

nodes.label: AWS Cost Estimate
nodes.description: Approximately $85/month for idle/low traffic deployment (NAT $32, Fargate $18, RDS $15, ALB $16, Secrets $2)
